entries.name: Airborne Riflemen
entries.notes: User-selected heavy rifle squad: rocket, LMGs and marksman. More demanding than a light airborne squad; no guided AT. Vanilla pattern: Airborne 2 / Desantniki.

entries.name: Airborne HJ-12 Team
entries.notes: Premium dedicated anti-tank team; escorts needed against infantry. Vanilla pattern: VDV Kornet.

entries.name: Airborne Close-Assault Riflemen
entries.notes: User-selected close-assault kit: light rockets, automatic rifles and underbarrel grenades; no long-range guided AT. Vanilla pattern: Airborne 2 / Desantniki.

entries.name: Airborne PF-98 Fire Support
entries.munitions: Fixed mix: HEAT + DZT-98 thermobaric; round counts to balance
entries.notes: Heavy direct support for landing zones; mixed AT/blast kit, slower than riflemen. Vanilla pattern: Rangers RAWS.

entries.name: Airborne QLU-11 Precision Team
entries.munitions: 35 mm HE-frag; no borrowed LG5 ammunition
entries.notes: Standoff explosive support; precision grenades, weak against MBTs. Vanilla pattern: Rangers Mk47 AGL.

entries.name: Airborne QJZ-171 Team
entries.notes: Dedicated lightweight HMG firebase; needs a rifle screen and transport. Vanilla pattern: M2 HMG team.

entries.name: Airborne Pathfinders
entries.notes: Small advance scout; spot first, avoid prolonged firefights. Vanilla pattern: Airborne Recce.

entries.name: Thunder Gods
entries.munitions: Limited QTS 20 mm HE/airburst-design allocation; capability requires testing
entries.notes: Elite air-mobile reconnaissance/raids; two digital grenadiers, no heavy ATGM. Vanilla pattern: Rangers RRC. Research: S03 (cell note).

entries.name: Airborne Snipers
entries.notes: Heavy sniper, marksman and security rifle; precision, not assault manpower. Vanilla pattern: Army Snipers.

entries.name: Airborne HN-6 Patrol
entries.notes: Infantry escort with one MANPADS; less ground firepower than riflemen. Vanilla pattern: VDV Igla.

entries.name: Air Assault Raiders
entries.notes: Compact shock infantry for helicopters; limited staying power. Vanilla pattern: VDV DSh 1.

entries.name: Airborne Assault Engineers
entries.notes: Close-range breaching with useful rifle security; no automatic mine-clearing bonus. Vanilla pattern: Mech. Engineers.

entries.name: Airborne QLZ-87 Team
entries.notes: Portable explosive-volume support; less precise than QLU-11 team. Vanilla pattern: VDV AGS-30.

entries.name: Airborne Target Observers
entries.munitions: 35 mm HE-frag; designator equipment is a proposal
entries.notes: Small spotting/coordination team; proposed designator role needs explicit ability support. Vanilla pattern: Airborne Recce.

entries.name: Airborne Reserve Riflemen
entries.notes: Lower-tier air-mobile reserve; manpower and simple weapons, no SF optics. Vanilla pattern: Reserve Marines.

entries.name: Mechanized Riflemen
entries.notes: Compact mechanized dismounts; IFV supplies extra fire support. Vanilla pattern: Mech. Riflemen MAAWS.

entries.name: Mechanized HJ-8E Team
entries.notes: Affordable guided AT; requires exposure while guiding, unlike HJ-12. Vanilla pattern: PTRK Konkurs.

entries.name: Mechanized QW-2 Team
entries.notes: Dedicated air defense, little spare infantry firepower. Vanilla pattern: Stinger team.

entries.name: Mechanized QLZ-04 Team
entries.notes: Sustained AGL position defense; heavy gun crew, not assault infantry. Vanilla pattern: Mk19 AGL team.

entries.name: Mechanized PF-98 Tank Hunters
entries.notes: Shorter-range unguided AT concentration; distinct from mixed-ammo fire support. Vanilla pattern: Assaultmen SMAW.

entries.name: Mechanized Combat Engineers
entries.notes: Clear defended positions with shotgun/assault launchers and rifle security. Vanilla pattern: Combat Engineers.

entries.name: Mechanized QJZ-89 Team
entries.notes: Dedicated heavy suppression; no missile or grenade capability. Vanilla pattern: M2 HMG team.

entries.name: Mechanized GPMG Riflemen
entries.notes: Suppression-heavy fixed kit; weaker on the move than standard dismounts. Vanilla pattern: Mech. Riflemen MMG.

entries.name: Mechanized Guided-AT Riflemen
entries.notes: Rifle squad trades heavy rocket burst for one guided AT weapon. Vanilla pattern: Mech. Riflemen Dragon.

entries.name: Armored Scouts
entries.notes: Small scouts screening armor; limited casualties can collapse firepower. Vanilla pattern: Cavalry Scouts.

entries.name: Armored Sniper Pair
entries.notes: Two-man precision team with almost no spare bodies. Vanilla pattern: Scout Snipers.

entries.name: Mechanized Thermobaric Breachers
entries.notes: Hard CQC/anti-cover specialist, deliberately poor at long-range AT. Vanilla pattern: Mech. Engineers CQC.

entries.name: Mechanized Close-AT Riflemen
entries.notes: Cheaper fixed light-AT loadout; guided team remains the MBT counter. Vanilla pattern: Motostrelki.

entries.name: Armored Forward Observers
entries.notes: Low-firepower observation unit for armor/artillery coordination. Vanilla pattern: Airborne Recce.

entries.name: Recon HJ-8E Ambush Team
entries.notes: Hidden observation and one guided ambush weapon; avoid infantry duels. Vanilla pattern: Cavalry Scouts.

entries.name: Conscripts — No AT
entries.notes: Cheap mass and screening only; deliberately no launcher. Vanilla pattern: Reserve Marines.

entries.name: Reserve Riflemen — HJ-73D
entries.notes: Reserve line squad with one upgraded-Malyutka launcher; affordable defensive AT is the design goal. Guidance exposure and launcher burden trade against mobile assault. Vanilla pattern: mixed rifle/AT squads. Research: S14 (cell note).

entries.name: Reserve HJ-73D Team
entries.munitions: Tandem HEAT missiles; reserve count TBD
entries.notes: Dedicated two-launcher reserve AT team; intended economy option below HJ-8E support. QBZ-95 security; poor infantry assault value. Continuous target tracking is the proposed guidance limitation. Research: S14 (cell note).

entries.name: Reserve HN-6 Team
entries.notes: Low-manpower air defense; needs a rifle screen. Vanilla pattern: PZRK Igla.

entries.name: Reserve QJZ-89 Team
entries.notes: Economy fixed HMG defense for launch sites and roads. Vanilla pattern: M2 HMG team.

entries.name: Reserve QLZ-87 Team
entries.notes: Defensive grenade volume; little mobile assault value. Vanilla pattern: VDV AGS-30.

entries.name: Reserve PF-98 Team
entries.notes: Dedicated unguided tank defense; support burden buys a lower-cost alternative to missiles. Vanilla pattern: Assaultmen SMAW.

entries.name: Malyutka Recon Ambush Team
entries.munitions: Tandem HEAT missiles; limited ambush reserve TBD
entries.notes: Six-man reserve recon/ambush team: observe a lane, take a prepared AT shot, then reposition. One HJ-73D plus DMR/LMG security. Recon Yes; Conscripts / QBZ-95. No automatic SF stealth, fire-and-forget or firing through blocked LOS. Research: S14 (cell note).

entries.name: Sharp Blades
entries.munitions: Limited QTS 20 mm grenades + light HEAT
entries.notes: Small high-value reconnaissance/security element; one digital grenadier, not a super-squad. Vanilla pattern: Green Berets. Research: S11 (cell note).

entries.name: Missile-Site Security — HJ-73D
entries.notes: Large reserve security squad gains one upgraded Malyutka for defensive armor ambushes. Heavy mixed kit favors prepared positions over assault. Launcher and squad model readiness still need checking. Research: S14 (cell note).

entries.name: Missile-Site Counter-Raid Team
entries.notes: Short-range security reserve; standard weapons, no special sensor bonus. Vanilla pattern: DLC3 Rosgvardia.

entries.name: Reserve Thermobaric Team
entries.notes: Positional anti-infantry blast team; cannot replace an ATGM. Vanilla pattern: Ognemetchiki.

entries.name: Reserve Heavy HJ-8E Team
entries.notes: Larger dual-launcher AT position with security; higher cost than single-launcher team. Vanilla pattern: PTRK Fagot.

entries.name: Rocket Convoy Escort — HJ-73D
entries.munitions: Tandem HEAT missiles; reserve count TBD
entries.notes: Ordinary escort infantry with one upgraded-Malyutka launcher for route-defense halts. Support-heavy fixed kit; intended low-cost AT coverage, no SF sensor bonus. Existing Regular / QBZ-191 baseline retained. Research: S14 (cell note).

entries.name: FHJ-02 Incendiary Team
entries.munitions: Fixed incendiary rockets; seven-tube launcher, reload balance TBD
entries.notes: Small infantry rocket-support crew; setup and resupply burden, no MBT role. Vanilla pattern: Green Berets Flash. Research: S12 (cell note).

entries.name: Godsword
entries.munitions: QTS 20 mm + QLU 35 mm HE; no automatic airburst/cover bonus
entries.notes: Signature high-tech explosive/precision squad; limited grenade reserves and no hard AT. Vanilla pattern: Delta Force. Research: S02 (cell note).
entries.source_design_name: Eastern Sword — Digital Assault (东方神剑)

entries.name: Whistling Arrows
entries.notes: Carbine/shotgun entry squad; hard CQC and breaching, little long-range punch. Vanilla pattern: SSO. Research: S02 (cell note).

entries.name: Blood Wolves
entries.munitions: HEAT only; cold-weather identity is flavor, not an automatic buff
entries.notes: Robust field assault with heavy unguided AT; not covert observation. Vanilla pattern: Spetsnaz GRU AT. Research: S05 (cell note).

entries.name: Sky Hunters
entries.munitions: QLU 35 mm HE + QBU-10 12.7 mm + 5.8 mm
entries.notes: SF standoff recon team: precision grenades and 12.7 mm sniper fire, with marksman/spotter and carbine security. Small team; no dedicated AT. User-requested fixed kit. Vanilla pattern: small mixed-weapon Green Berets / sniper teams. Research S06 supports the sniper theme, not this exact equipment mix.
entries.source_design_name: Sky Wolves — QLU / Sniper Recon (天狼)

entries.name: Southern Swords
entries.notes: Standoff grenade/GPMG support; suppresses infantry but lacks premium guided AT. Vanilla pattern: Green Berets. Research: S07 (cell note).
entries.source_design_name: Southern Sharp Swords — Fire Support (南国利剑)
entries.identity: Nanguo Lijian / Huanan Zhi Jian (南国利剑 / 华南之剑)

entries.name: Mountain Hunters
entries.notes: Light mountain fighting with marksmen; no HMG, missile or free terrain bonus. Vanilla pattern: Gornostrelki. Research: S08 (cell note).
entries.source_design_name: Plateau Snow Leopards — Mountain Team (高原雪豹)
entries.identity: Gaoyuan Xuebao (高原雪豹), plateau special operations

entries.name: Blue Sword
entries.munitions: SMG ammunition + buckshot; no explosive launcher
entries.notes: Police-themed room-clearing specialist; excellent CQC identity, no AT. Vanilla pattern: DLC3 Spetsnaz Vympel CQC. Research: S01 (cell note).
entries.identity: Beijing Public Security Blue Sword / Lanjian (蓝剑)

entries.name: Falcon
entries.munitions: Limited 20 mm HE + buckshot + assault rounds
entries.notes: PAP rapid-entry squad with small digital-grenade element; no heavy ATGM. Vanilla pattern: SSO. Research: S04 (cell note).

entries.name: PAP Snow Leopards
entries.munitions: 35 mm HE + buckshot; exact issued kit not asserted
entries.notes: Compact CT raid kit; suppressed weapon concept without free invisibility. Vanilla pattern: Force Recon CQC. Research: S09 (cell note).
entries.source_design_name: PAP Snow Leopards — Raid Team (雪豹)

entries.name: Sea Dragons
entries.notes: Marine SOF assault manpower; heavy rocket support, less compact than scouts. Vanilla pattern: Marine Raiders AT. Research: S10 (cell note).
entries.identity: PLA Navy Marine Corps Jiaolong (蛟龙)

entries.name: Sea Dragons Recon
entries.munitions: Assault rounds; no heavy anti-tank weapon
entries.notes: Maritime reconnaissance/raid team; no automatic swimming/diving ability implied. Vanilla pattern: Force Recon. Research: S10 (cell note).
entries.identity: PLA Navy Marine Corps Jiaolong (蛟龙)

entries.name: Marine Riflemen
entries.notes: Large sustained-assault squad; manpower rather than elite stealth. Vanilla pattern: Marines.

entries.name: Marine HJ-12 Team
entries.notes: Dedicated premium armor counter with a security gun. Vanilla pattern: CAAT Javelin.

entries.name: Marine HN-6 Team
entries.notes: Marine air-defense team with limited self-protection. Vanilla pattern: Rangers Stinger.

entries.name: Marine Thermobaric Engineers
entries.notes: Breach fortified infantry positions; weak versus heavy armor. Vanilla pattern: Combat Engineers.

entries.name: Motorized Line Infantry
entries.notes: User-selected mixed kit retained; versatile but expensive and less specialized than support teams. Vanilla pattern: Troopers.

entries.name: Motorized Troopers — AA
entries.notes: Troopers-style mixed AA squad; trades anti-tank slot for MANPADS. Vanilla pattern: Troopers AA.

entries.name: Motorized Troopers — HJ-12
entries.notes: Separate guided-AT trooper unit, matched in size to AA troopers. Vanilla pattern: Troopers AT.

entries.name: Motorized Weapons Squad
entries.notes: User-selected grenade/HMG/sniper firebase; broad standoff coverage, limited assault manpower. No guided anti-tank weapon. Vanilla pattern: DLC2 HMG GMG.

entries.name: Motorized PF-98 Fire Support
entries.munitions: Also thermo | Draft: Fixed mix: HEAT + DZT-98 thermobaric; reserve count TBD
entries.notes: Small direct-fire team with the user-requested mixed AT/thermobaric kit. Vanilla pattern: Assaultmen SMAW.

entries.name: Motorized Recon Patrol
entries.notes: Mobile forward screen with one marksman and light self-defense AT. Vanilla pattern: Scouts.

entries.name: Motorized Snipers
entries.notes: Heavy rifle and marksman with security; cannot hold a line. Vanilla pattern: Army Snipers.

entries.name: Eagles Recon
entries.munitions: Limited 20 mm HE + light HEAT; designator is a proposed role
entries.notes: Networked target-finding theme with limited digital grenades; spotting over brute assault. Vanilla pattern: Rangers RRC. Research: S13 (cell note).
entries.source_design_name: Taishan Eagles — Deep Recon (泰山雄鹰)
entries.identity: Xiongying (雄鹰), historical Jinan-region SOF lineage

entries.name: Motorized CQC Engineers
entries.notes: Close-range engineer kit; no long-range AT or heavy MG. Vanilla pattern: Mech. Engineers CQC.

entries.name: Motorized Light-AT Riflemen
entries.notes: Cheaper fixed kit than the heavy mixed line squad. Vanilla pattern: Troopers.

entries.name: Motorized Air-Defense Scouts
entries.notes: Forward observer with a single defensive SAM; not a full AA battery. Vanilla pattern: VDV Igla.

entries.name: Motorized PF-98 Tank Hunters
entries.notes: AT-only counterpart to the mixed-ammo fire-support team. Vanilla pattern: Rangers RAWS.

entries.name: Motorized QLZ-04 Team
entries.notes: Sustained grenade firebase; needs transport and a front line. Vanilla pattern: Mk19 AGL team.

entries.name: Motorized Thermobaric Assault
entries.notes: Dedicated blast assault; gives up heavy AT and long-range suppression. Vanilla pattern: Ognemetchiki.

entries.name: Motorized CAAT — HJ-8E / QLU-11
entries.munitions: HJ-8E tandem HEAT + QLU 35 mm HE + 7.62 mm GPMG
entries.notes: Mixed AT/infantry-support team: one guided launcher, one precision GL and one GPMG; remaining personnel provide rifle security and crew support. Eight-man CAAT-style fixed kit, less suited to mobile assault. Exact price and weapon stats TBD.

entries.name: Test — Export Riflemen
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Export-rifle comparison; a game test kit, not an asserted issued squad. Vanilla pattern: Motostrelki.

entries.name: Test — SMG Assault
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — All-short-range assault benchmark; deliberately no armor counter. Vanilla pattern: Force Recon CQC.

entries.name: Test — Suppressed Scouts
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Quiet-weapon reconnaissance benchmark; actual signature needs testing. Vanilla pattern: DLC2 KNT.

entries.name: Test — LG5 Precision Grenadiers
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Export precision-GL team; separate from domestic QLU-11. Vanilla pattern: Rangers Mk47 AGL.

entries.name: Test — LG5s Mobile Grenadiers
entries.munitions: LG5s configuration to verify; 35 mm carried separately
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Lighter export precision-support layout; no automatic mobility buff. Vanilla pattern: Green Berets.

entries.name: Test — LG6 CQC Grenadiers
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Short-range grenade/shotgun burst kit, not long-range AGL support. Vanilla pattern: Marine Raiders CQC.

entries.name: Test — LG4 Revolver Team
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Six-shot MGL-style burst-support benchmark. Vanilla pattern: Delta Force.

entries.name: Test — LG3 Heavy AGL
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Heavy sustained export grenade support; setup burden to balance. Vanilla pattern: Mk19 AGL team.

entries.name: Test — QN-202 Guided Support
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Light guided support against soft/light targets; not a Javelin replacement. Vanilla pattern: Green Berets.

entries.name: Test — TL-4 Team
entries.munitions: Tandem HEAT; guidance modes require validation
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Long-range export ATGM concept; foot-team/model suitability unresolved. Vanilla pattern: TOW-2A.

entries.name: Test — GAM-102LR Team
entries.munitions: Tandem HEAT; no native range imported from advertisements
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Export long-range missile concept; deployment scale not yet locked. Vanilla pattern: TOW-2A.

entries.name: Test — HJ-12E Team
entries.munitions: Tandem HEAT; domestic/export stats not assumed equal
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Export missile variant kept separate from domestic HJ-12. Vanilla pattern: VDV Kornet.

entries.name: Test — QW-2 Escort
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Mobile AA-escort comparison with modest ground defense. Vanilla pattern: VDV Igla.

entries.name: Test — QTS Recon Cell
entries.munitions: Limited 20 mm grenades; no assumed sensor/airburst bonus
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Small digital-recon alternative to Eastern Sword assault manpower. Vanilla pattern: Green Berets.

entries.name: Test — FHJ-02 Smoke Team
entries.munitions: Smoke rockets only; behavior and reload need implementation
entries.notes: TEST CONCEPT — Separate smoke-screen unit, not an ammunition option on incendiary team. Vanilla pattern: Green Berets Flash. Research: S12 (cell note).

limits: Names, sizes, selected weapons and quantities match the sheet. Weapon performance, ammo stocks, costs and armor tiers are native analog drafts. Custom meshes used where installed; remaining handhelds use native meshes.
